WORKING NOTES
- Original prompt is long; a trimmed version may give more controlled
results.
- Consider adding a film stock anchor such as "35mm, Kodak Portra."
Try this: Add a 35mm Kodak Portra film-stock reference.
IMAGE PROMPT
A vertical portrait of a young woman with long
light-brown hair and freckles, wearing a
wide-brimmed black hat with a dark fabric rosette
and a high-necked black top with textured lace-like
detailing. She glances over her shoulder toward the
camera with a calm, slightly serious expression.
Shot from mid-thigh up with a shallow depth of
field, the background a soft blur of autumn foliage
in amber and gold at the top left, fading into deep
green. Soft, diffused natural daylight, muted
warm-cool palette dominated by blacks and
greens, with gentle film grain and vintage 1970s
color rendering. Melancholic, romantic,
Victorian-inspired mood, cinematic and nostalgic.
